info.name: Grocery List
info.summary: Shared grocery lists, sorted the way you walk through the store
info.description:
Keep your grocery lists in Nextcloud and shop together.
- **Categories in store order**: group items into categories, give them colors and drag them into the order you walk through your store - **Check off and snooze**: check items off while shopping, or snooze an item for 15 minutes when you cannot find it right now - **Focus on what is left**: show only unchecked items, or switch to an A–Z list with a letter index - **Share lists**: share a list with other users of your Nextcloud so everyone can add and check off items - **Mobile friendly**: works well on the phone in the store
info.author: Tobias Kaminsky
